name: FortiWeb — SSRF Out-of-Band DNS Callback
description: Detects HTTP requests containing URLs that point to out-of-band SSRF interaction domains (Burp Collaborator, interactsh, oast.fun, canarytokens) or to the cloud metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254) — Server-Side Request Forgery exploitation using an external callback.
false_positives: Documentation links — extremely rare on a real customer surface.
ngrok-using developers behind the corporate proxy — exclude

tactic.name: if SSRF chains to internal pivot

technique.name:
Exploit Public-Facing Application
- **T1133** — External Remote Services

query:
FROM logs* METADATA _id, _version, _index
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 minutes
        AND data.packet.packet IS NOT NULL
| EVAL u = TO_LOWER(data.packet.packet)
| WHERE
       u LIKE "*169.254.169.254*"
    OR u LIKE "*metadata.google.internal*"
    OR u LIKE "*100.100.100.200*"
    OR u LIKE "*oast.fun*"
    OR u LIKE "*oast.online*"
    OR u LIKE "*oast.live*"
    OR u LIKE "*interactsh*"
    OR u LIKE "*burpcollaborator.net*"
    OR u LIKE "*requestbin.net*"
    OR u LIKE "*requestbin.com*"
    OR u LIKE "*pipedream.net*"
    OR u LIKE "*ngrok.io*"
    OR u LIKE "*ngrok-free.app*"
    OR u LIKE "*canarytokens.com*"
    OR u LIKE "*dnslog.cn*"
    OR u LIKE "*ceye.io*"
    OR u LIKE "*xip.io*"
    OR u LIKE "*nip.io*"
    OR u LIKE "*sslip.io*"
    OR u LIKE "*gopher://*"
    OR u LIKE "*file:///*"
    OR u LIKE "*dict://*"
    OR u LIKE "*http://localhost*"
    OR u LIKE "*http://127.0.0.1*"
    OR u LIKE "*http://0.0.0.0*"
| KEEP _id, _index, @timestamp, x_forwarded_for, data.packet.packet, data.http_method, data.http_agent
| LIMIT 200
